earnings_release.text: EX-99.1 2 exhibit991q32026.htm EX-99.1 Document For Immediate Release Hasbro Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results Magic: The Gathering Surpasses $600 million in Quarterly Revenue for First Time Raises 2026 Financial Outlook & Doubles Share Repurchase Target Pawtucket, R.I., October 20, 2026 – Hasbro, Inc. (NASDAQ: HAS), a leading games, IP, and toy company, today reported financial results for the third quarter 2026. “Inspiring a lifetime of play is our superpower, and this quarter showed what it can do,” said Chris Cocks, Hasbro Chief Executive Officer. “We delivered a fourth consecutive quarter of double-digit revenue growth, and Magic: The Gathering topped $600 million in quarterly revenue for the first time. Our asset-light licensing model lets great partners extend our brands while we focus on what we do best. With a Magic lineup that keeps building, we expect a strong finish to 2026 and continued growth in 2027.” “This quarter again showed the power of Hasbro’s brand portfolio paired with strong execution,” said Gina Goetter, Hasbro Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer. “Given this momentum, we are raising our 2026 outlook and doubling our share repurchase target for the year, balancing investment in the business with returning cash to shareholders.” Third Quarter 2026 Results • Hasbro, Inc.'s revenue increased 15% vs. LY, driven by growth in Wizards and Digital Gaming (+31%), Consumer Products (+4%), and Entertainment (+9%). • Operating profit was $517 million and Adjusted operating profit was $541 million (+52% vs. LY), reflecting topline momentum, favorable mix and cost productivity. • Results include approximately $55 million of tariff refunds. • Reported net earnings were $2.77 per diluted share and Adjusted net earnings per diluted share were $2.90. • Returned $206 million to shareholders through the quarterly dividend and share repurchases. • During the quarter, the Company deployed $79 million toward debt reduction through open-market bond repurchases and U.S. Treasury purchases to prefund the 2026 and 2027 bond maturities. Third Quarter 2026 Segment Details • Wizards and Digital Gaming Segment ▪ Revenue increased 31%, led by Magic: The Gathering (+34%). Digital and licensed gaming grew 3%. ▪ Magic: The Gathering growth fueled by The Hobbit and Reality Fracture . ▪ Monopoly Go! contributed $41 million of revenue in the third quarter. ▪ Operating profit of $ 367 million (+46% vs. LY), with a 49% operating margin, includes a $7 million benefit from tariff refunds. • Consumer Products Segment • Revenues were up 4% in the quarter, led by Marvel , KPop Demon Hunters and Transformers . • Q3 sales benefited from entertainment releases, including Spider-Man: Brand New Day , and continued momentum in GEM 2 categories. • Operating profit of $174 million and Adjusted operating profit of $178 million (+100% vs. LY) driven by productivity initiatives. Operating profit and adjusted operating profit include a $48 million benefit from tariff refunds. • Entertainment Segment • Revenue increased 9%, driven by growth in Family Brands. • Operating profit of $17 million and Adjusted operating profit of $18 million up 63% due to favorable licensing mix. Year-to-Date 2026 Results • Year-to-date Hasbro, Inc. revenue increased 15% vs. LY, driven by growth in Wizards and Digital Gaming (+28%) and Consumer Products (+3%), partially offset by a decline in Entertainment (-13%). • Operating profit was $1,040 million and Adjusted operating profit was $1,110 million (+35% vs. LY), reflecting a strong topline. Both figures include a $56 million impairment related to digital games, nearly offset by a $55 million benefit from tariff refunds. • Reported net earnings were $5.27 per diluted share and Adjusted net earnings per diluted share were $5.65. • Returned $445 million to shareholders through the quarterly dividend and share repurchases. • During the first nine months, the Company deployed $226 million toward debt reduction through open-market bond repurchases and U.S. Treasury purchases to prefund the 2026 and 2027 maturities. Year-to-Date 2026 Segment Details • Wizards and Digital Gaming Segment • Revenue increased 28%, led by Magic: The Gathering (+34%). Digital and licensed gaming grew 7%. • Magic: The Gathering benefited from growth in tabletop and digital revenues, across first-party and Universes Beyond sets. • Year-to-date Monopoly Go! contributed $127 million of revenue. • Operating profit of $935 m illion (+29% vs. LY), with a 47% operating margin, which includes a $56 million impairment related to the Company’s refocused digital games portfolio. • Consumer Products Segment • Revenues increased 3% as Marvel, Star Wars, Beyblade, and KPop Demon Hunters more than offset disruptions from the previously disclosed unauthorized network access. • Operating profit o f $112 million and Adjusted operating profit of $130 million (+119% vs. LY) driven by productivity improvements. • Entertainment Segment • Revenue decline of 13% related to the nature and timing of deals. • Operating profit of $40 million and Adjusted operating profit o f $47 million (+22% vs. LY) primarily due to lower program amortization. See the financial tables accompanying the press release for a reconciliation of GAAP to non-GAAP financial measures. 2026 Company Outlook and Capital Allocation For the full year, the Company now expects: • Total Hasbro revenue up 7-9% in constant currency (previously up 5-7% in constant currency) • Adjusted operating margin of 27-28% (previously 25-26%) • Adjusted EBITDA of $1.575 billion to $1.625 billion (previously $1.45 billion to $1.50 billion) 2026 Capital Allocation priorities: • Invest in core business. • Return cash to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases. • Continue to pay down debt. Dividend Announcement During the third quarter, the Company paid $99 million in cash dividends to shareholders. The Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.70 per common share payable on December 2, 2026, to shareholders of record at the close of business on November 18, 2026. Conference Call Webcast Hasbro will webcast its third quarter 2026 earnings conference call at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time today. To listen to the live webcast and access the accompanying presentation slides, please go to https://investor.hasbro.com. The replay of the call will be available on Hasbro’s website approximately two hours following completion of the call. About Hasbro Hasbro is a leading games, IP and toy company whose mission is to create joy and community through the magic of play. With 165 years of expertise, Hasbro delivers groundbreaking play experiences and reaches more than 1 billion fans annually around the world, through physical and digital games, video games, toys, licensed consumer products, location-based entertainment, film, TV and more. Through its franchise-first approach, Hasbro unlocks value from both new and legacy IP, including Magic: The Gathering, Dungeons & Dragons, Monopoly, Hasbro Games, Nerf, Transformers, Play-Doh and Peppa Pig, as well as premier partner brands. Powered by its portfolio of thousands of iconic marks and a diversified network of partners and subsidiary studios, Hasbro brings fans together wherever they are, from tabletop to screen. For more than a decade, Hasbro has been consistently recognized for its corporate citizenship, including being named one of the 100 Best Corporate Citizens by 3BL Media, a 2026 JUST Capital Industry Leader, a Brand that Matters by Fast Company, and one of the 50 Most Community-Minded Companies in the U.S. by the Civic 50 for fourteen consecutive years. For more information, visit https://corporate.hasbro.com or follow Hasbro on LinkedIn. © 2026 Hasbro, Inc. All Rights Reserved. reference.summary: Hasbro, Inc. operates as a toy and game company in the United States, Europe, Canada, Mexico, Latin America, Australia, China, and Hong Kong. The company offers trading cards and collectibles, action figures, arts and crafts and creative play products, dolls, play sets, preschool toys, plush products, vehicles and toy-related specialty products, sports action products and accessories, and other consumer products; and licensed products, such as apparel, publishing products, home goods and electronics, and toy products. It also engages in the sourcing, marketing, and sale of toy and game products; and promotes its brands through the out-licensing of trademarks, characters, and other brand and intellectual property rights to third parties through the sale of branded consumer products, such as toys and apparel.
